edit.createVmOnly: New players are created by the club manager. As a team manager you cannot save here.
edit.emailHint: Optional. Used for notifications about license issuance, transfer status and more.
edit.correctionHint: If a player's master data was recorded incorrectly, you can request a correction here. The responsible SBK reviews and approves the change.
edit.correctionSent: Your correction request has been submitted.
edit.mergeHint: Select the duplicate profile from your club's active players. The responsible SBK reviews the request.
edit.mergeSelectedHint: Once approved, this profile will be merged into the currently opened profile and deactivated.
edit.licenseSuspendReasonPlaceholder: e.g. match ban after red card
edit.clubChangeHint: Club changes are handled through the transfer requests. A direct change without club and player confirmation is made there via the "Direct assignment" button.
edit.documentsLoadError: Documents could not be loaded. You may not have permission to view them.
edit.documentTypesLoadError: The document types could not be loaded. Uploading is not possible without them.
edit.noDocumentTypes: No document type is available for this player.
edit.documentReplaceHint: A new document of this type replaces the existing one:
edit.documentUploadHint: Allowed: PDF, PNG and JPEG up to 10 MB.
edit.documentTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
edit.documentUploadFailed: The document could not be uploaded.
edit.documentDeleteFailed: The document could not be deleted.
edit.deactivatedHint: This player is deactivated and no longer appears in the club's active player list. Club memberships and licences are unaffected, and the player remains findable in the player search and in transfer and release requests. Older deactivations still invalidated the player's licences; those stay invalid and are not reverted retroactively.
edit.deactivateWarning: The player will be removed from the club's active player list and from the selection for licence applications. Club memberships and licences remain unchanged, and the player stays findable in the player search and in transfer and release requests.
edit.suspensionsHint: A single license is suspended above per team. An application block suspends all active licenses and prevents new license applications until the expiry date.
edit.applicationBlockWarning: All currently active licenses of the player will be suspended. New license applications are not possible until the expiry date.
edit.gfRoleErstTitle: First license in adult large-field play – full eligibility
edit.gfRoleZweitTitle: Second license in adult large-field play – restricted eligibility (e.g. no FD cup)
edit.gfRoleSwapHint: One swap per season is allowed; further swaps only by the FD administration.
